Group's cancellation notice must cite the specific National Weather Service warning upon which the cancellation is based and must be received by the Hotel's Director of Sales or designated event manager. This named storm cancellation right shall expire and become unavailable to Group if cancellation notice is not received by the Hotel within the twenty-four (24) hour window following the warning issuance.
findings.headline: 24-hour window and Group-only right to cancel for storms
findings.finding_text: The right lapses unless notice reaches the Hotel within 24 hours, is available to Group only, and requires a specific citation. Severity kept at the default although the April event dates are outside hurricane season.
findings.cd_standard: Either party may cancel the affected portion without liability when a named storm is forecast within 72 hours, whether or not damage results, on written or verbal notice followed by writing.
findings.proposed_language: In the event a named storm (hurricane, tropical storm) is forecast to affect the Hotel's location within 72 hours of any event date, either party may cancel the affected portion of the event without liability upon written or verbal (followed by written) notice, regardless of whether the storm ultimately causes physical damage to the Hotel.

findings.quoted_text: In the event the Hotel is unable to provide accommodations to any guest for whom a reservation has been guaranteed under this Agreement, the Hotel shall make a reasonable effort to secure alternative lodging at the guest's sole expense and cost. Any booking made by the Hotel at an alternative hotel shall be confirmed in writing to the guest, and the guest shall bear all costs associated with such alternative accommodations, including but not limited to room rates, taxes, and resort fees charged by the substitute hotel.
findings.headline: Walked guests pay for their own replacement lodging
findings.finding_text: Displaced attendees bear all costs, with no advance contact, walk priority or do-not-walk list.
findings.cd_standard: Advance contact, transients walked first, do-not-walk list, comparable accommodations at Hotel's expense.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel is unable to accommodate any member of Group holding a confirmed reservation, Hotel will contact Group in advance, will not walk members of Group before transient guests and other groups, and will review Group's attendee list with Group to identify those who cannot be walked under any circumstances. For each displaced guest, Hotel will, at its own expense, provide accommodations at a comparable hotel as close as possible, at no charge to the guest, for each night the guest is displaced. Any booking made by the Hotel at an alternative hotel shall be confirmed in writing to the guest.
findings.redline_note: Puts the cost of relocation on the Hotel and gives the group advance notice and priority protection.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall assign all function space for the Group's use during the Event at the Hotel's sole discretion, and no function room is named or reserved in this Agreement. The Group acknowledges that the Hotel retains the right to change any function space assignment at any time by written notice to the Group's authorized representative, provided that such reassignment shall not materially diminish the aggregate square footage or suitability of space made available to the Group. Any audio-visual, catering, or other services contracted for a particular function space shall transfer to the reassigned space, and the Group shall not be entitled to any reduction in charges, waiver of fees, or claim for damages by reason of any such change.
findings.headline: No rooms reserved; Hotel may reassign space at will
findings.finding_text: No rooms, square footage or ceiling heights are fixed in the body, and the Hotel can reassign at will.
findings.cd_standard: Each function room named with minimum square footage and ceiling height; no change without both parties' written consent.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will hold the function space listed in Exhibit A and will specify each function space assignment, minimum square footage ([X] square feet), and ceiling height requirement ([X] feet) in this Agreement. No change will be made to the function space assignments without the written consent of both parties. Any audio-visual, catering, or other services contracted for a particular function space shall transfer to any agreed reassigned space.
findings.redline_note: Fixes function room assignments and requires mutual consent to change them.

findings.quoted_text: Reservations for rooms within the block committed for the National Association of Coastal Engineers event shall be accepted by the Hotel only when received on or before forty-five (45) days prior to the arrival date of April 12, 2027. This cutoff date is firm and is established to allow the Hotel adequate time to manage inventory, coordinate staffing, and finalize event logistics. Reservations requested after this cutoff date shall be handled exclusively through the Hotel's reservations department and shall not be processed as group reservations subject to the group rate negotiated for this event.
findings.headline: Cutoff set at 45 days, with no group reservations after
findings.finding_text: A 45-day cutoff is 24 days earlier than the 21-day maximum, shortening the time attendees have to book at the group rate.
findings.cd_standard: Cutoff 21 days or fewer before arrival.
findings.proposed_language: Reservations for rooms within the block committed for the National Association of Coastal Engineers event shall be accepted by the Hotel at the group rate when received on or before twenty-one (21) days prior to the arrival date of April 12, 2027. This cutoff date is firm and is established to allow the Hotel adequate time to manage inventory, coordinate staffing, and finalize event logistics.
findings.redline_note: Moves the cutoff closer to arrival so attendees have more time to book.
findings.compromise_range: 21–30 days before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall not be obligated to provide the Group with advance written notice regarding the expiration date, renewal status, or proposed modification of any collective bargaining agreement, union contract, or labor accord to which the Hotel is a party. The Group acknowledges that information regarding labor relations, union negotiations, and collective bargaining agreement timelines is confidential business information of the Hotel and shall not be disclosed to the Group unless the Hotel, in its sole discretion, determines that such disclosure is appropriate.
findings.headline: No notice of union contract expirations or disputes
findings.finding_text: Group gets no advance warning of contract expirations or labor disputes, so it cannot assess strike risk.
findings.cd_standard: One year's notice of CBA expiration dates; written notice within 10 working days of any labor dispute.
findings.proposed_language: One (1) year in advance, or within thirty (30) days of signing this Agreement if that is later, Hotel will provide Group in writing a list of all collective bargaining agreement expiration dates for the ensuing year. Hotel will notify Group in writing within ten (10) working days after becoming aware of any labor dispute involving Hotel's employees, including picketing, an expired labor contract, or an existing or impending strike, lockout, or boycott.
findings.redline_note: Requires advance notice of contract expirations and prompt notice of labor disputes.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group cancel this agreement at any time after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of gross room revenue that would have been earned by the Hotel for all guest rooms for all nights within the event period of April 12-16, 2027, based upon the negotiated room rate and the full room block size.
findings.headline: Damages based on gross revenue, not room profit
findings.finding_text: Percentages apply to full gross revenue on the full block, with no allowance for attrition or cost savings, and tier dollar amounts are not stated.
findings.cd_standard: Sliding scale on room profit (70% of single net rate times block less allowable attrition), with dollar amount per tier disclosed; actual damages only.
findings.proposed_language: Should Group cancel this agreement after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of room profit on the sliding scale below, based on the date written notice of cancellation is received, and the dollar amount owed at each tier will be stated in this Agreement as [X]. One hundred percent (100%) of room profit is defined as seventy percent (70%) of the confirmed single net group rate at the time of cancellation, multiplied by the final adjusted room block less allowable attrition. Any award for breach of this Agreement is limited to actual damages; punitive damages will not apply.
findings.redline_note: Bases cancellation damages on room profit and states the amount at each tier.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: A service charge and gratuity shall be added to all food and beverage, banquet, and room charges, and the terms 'gratuity' and 'service charge' shall be used interchangeably throughout this Agreement and are not separately defined. The combined gratuity and service charge shall be automatically applied at the rate of twenty-four percent (24%) of the subtotal of all covered charges before tax. Group shall not dispute this automatic application, and the Service Charge shall be due and payable by Group without exception or reduction.
findings.headline: Gratuity and service charge merged and applied to room charges
findings.finding_text: The two charges are not separately defined and are applied to room charges and banquets alike.
findings.cd_standard: Gratuity and service charge separately defined with both percentages confirmed; neither added to meeting room rental or equipment with labor fee.
findings.proposed_language: Eighteen percent (18%) of the food and beverage total, plus applicable tax, will be added to Group's account as a gratuity and fully distributed to the servers, and where applicable, bussers and bartenders assigned to the Event. Any service charge of six percent (6%), plus applicable tax, is separate from gratuity, is not distributed as a tip, and is retained by Hotel to cover the discretionary costs of the Event. Both percentages are confirmed in this Agreement. Hotel will not add a gratuity or service charge to meeting room rental fees or to any rented equipment that also carries a labor fee.

findings.quoted_text: In the event the Hotel wrongfully cancels this Agreement, the Hotel's sole obligation and the Group's exclusive remedy shall be the refund of any deposits paid by the Group to the Hotel, without interest and without liability for any other costs, losses, or damages incurred by the Group in connection with the event.
findings.headline: Wrongful Hotel cancellation limited to deposit refund
findings.finding_text: If the Hotel cancels without the right to, the group recovers only deposits and cannot claim relocation, rate difference, travel or other costs, and bears its own legal fees. The Hotel may also cancel in its sole discretion on 30 days' notice, leaving the group to find a new venue at its own expense.
findings.cd_standard: If the hotel cancels the agreement without a right to do so under the contract, it should owe the group all direct, indirect, and consequential damages including staff time and travel to find a new venue, room rate and airfare differences, function space rental, attorney's fees, and communication and printing costs, not just a refund of deposits.

findings.quoted_text: Where the Hotel has not approved credit for the Group, the Hotel may require prepayment in such amount as the Hotel determines to be appropriate before rooms are held, facilities are reserved, or services are rendered. The Group acknowledges that the determination of any required prepayment amount is within the Hotel's sole discretion and shall be binding on the Group upon written notice.
findings.headline: Open-ended prepayment at Hotel's discretion
findings.finding_text: Prepayment amount is unlimited and has no staged schedule, and credit is not automatic if the Hotel never sends an application.
findings.cd_standard: Credit extended automatically if Hotel fails to send or follow up on an application; if denied, 25% within 14 business days, 25% one month out, 50% three days before.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel fails to send Group a credit application, or fails to send a written reminder to complete it, Hotel will extend credit to Group. If credit is denied, Group will pay twenty-five percent (25%) of estimated charges within fourteen (14) business days of the denial, twenty-five percent (25%) one (1) month prior to the Event, and fifty percent (50%) three (3) days before the Event.
findings.redline_note: Replaces discretionary prepayment with a defined payment schedule.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: Upon release of any room inventory or function space by Group, whether through attrition, cancellation, or other reduction of Group's commitment, the Hotel shall have no obligation to attempt to resell such released inventory or function space, nor shall the Hotel be required to undertake any specific actions, marketing efforts, or promotional activities directed toward filling released space. The Hotel's decision to attempt resale, the means by which resale is pursued, the pricing at which space is offered, the priority given to such resale efforts as against other Hotel business, and the duration of any resale efforts shall be entirely within the Hotel's sole discretion. Group shall not have standing to challenge the Hotel's decisions regarding resale efforts, marketing strategies, or the business judgment exercised in connection with released inventory.
findings.headline: Hotel has no duty to resell released rooms or space
findings.finding_text: The Hotel may do nothing to resell and still collect full damages.
findings.cd_standard: Affirmative documented duty to resell through all group and transient channels.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will undertake all reasonable efforts to resell canceled or released rooms and food and beverage functions. Hotel will document in writing its efforts to market the dates proactively through all group and transient channels, including offering the released rooms through Hotel's reservations department.
findings.redline_note: Requires documented efforts to resell released rooms and space.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.quoted_text: Attrition is measured on a night-by-night basis, with shortfalls calculated by comparing actual rooms occupied to the block size on each night of the event period. Group shall be deemed in attrition if actual occupancy falls below the attrition threshold of ninety percent (90%) on any night. The Hotel shall calculate attrition based on the Hotel's registration records and room records, which constitute the final and binding record of occupancy for purposes of this agreement.
findings.headline: Night-by-night attrition with a 90% threshold
findings.finding_text: Each night is tested separately against 90% of its block, rather than cumulatively against 70% of the whole block, and Hotel records are final.
findings.cd_standard: Cumulative measurement across the whole block with liability only below 70% of the block; audit rights.
findings.proposed_language: Attrition liability, if any, will be calculated on a cumulative (not night-by-night) basis across the entire room block, with liability triggered only if Group's actual pickup falls below seventy percent (70%) of the total contracted room block. At Group's request, Hotel will provide a copy of its city ledger or daily report showing the information needed to verify the calculation.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel's determination of occupancy, calculation of attrition damages, and assessment of liability shall be final and binding upon Group. The Hotel's occupancy records, registration cards, and room-by-room occupancy logs shall not be open to Group for audit, verification, or inspection, and Group waives any right to independently verify the Hotel's calculations or to contest the Hotel's occupancy records on any basis.
findings.headline: Hotel's attrition calculation is final with no audit
findings.finding_text: Group cannot verify or contest the damages, and nothing says payment settles room block damages or credits them on rebooking.
findings.cd_standard: Audit rights; formula-based calculation; payment settles all block damages; damages credited on a CD client's rebooking; excess F&B credited.
findings.proposed_language: At Group's request, Hotel will provide a copy of its city ledger or daily report showing the information needed to verify the calculation, and Group may audit the Hotel's occupancy records. After receipt of this payment, Hotel will not seek additional damages from Group related to the room block commitment. Any excess food and beverage revenue above Group's F&B minimum will be credited dollar for dollar against room attrition damages, and vice versa. Should a ConferenceDirect client rebook the Hotel for another meeting within three (3) years, Hotel will credit up to 100% of the attrition damages paid toward the new booking's room revenue, not to exceed the damages paid; if the rebooking group is not the group that paid, the credit will be refunded directly to the group that paid.
findings.redline_note: Adds verification rights, settlement of block damages and a credit on rebooking.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: In addition to the Hotel's own use, Group authorizes the Hotel to share and disclose attendee data with the Hotel's corporate affiliates, brand partners, and third-party marketing service providers who assist the Hotel in analyzing market trends, identifying corporate event opportunities, and promoting the Hotel's services and facilities to potential group customers.
findings.headline: Attendee data may be marketed and shared with third parties
findings.finding_text: The Hotel may use attendee information for its own marketing and share it with affiliates and marketers without further notice, and the group waives claims over data handling. Attendees' privacy and the group's relationship with its members could be affected.
findings.cd_standard: Rooming list and attendee data provided to the hotel for reservation purposes should not be used by the hotel for its own marketing or sold to third parties without the group's consent.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel reserves the right to commence, continue, or complete any construction, renovation, or maintenance work at any time without providing the Group with advance written notice, and without restriction as to timing, scope, noise level, dust, disruption to guest services, or impact on guest experience. No work order, contractor engagement, or project timeline shall be subject to the Group's approval or consent.
findings.headline: Hotel may renovate at any time without notice
findings.finding_text: Work can proceed with unlimited noise and disruption and no notice.
findings.cd_standard: 30 days' written notice with scope, schedule, impact and mitigation plan; work will not interfere with Group's use.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel later confirms any such plans, Hotel will notify Group in writing within thirty (30) days, describing: (a) the planned scope of the project; (b) the schedule for commencement and completion; (c) the anticipated impact on areas Group will use; and (d) Hotel's plan for minimizing that impact. Hotel promises that any such construction or remodeling will not interfere with Group's use of the Hotel, and the parties will negotiate in good faith to resolve any concerns and amend this Agreement as needed.
findings.redline_note: Requires advance notice of renovation plans and a commitment not to interfere with the event.
findings.compromise_range: Written notice within 30–60 days of plans being confirmed.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall receive no credit toward its block commitment for nights on which the Hotel sells out all available rooms in the Hotel, and occupancy on such nights shall be deemed to have satisfied the threshold regardless of the actual number of rooms occupied from the block.
findings.headline: No block credit for high-occupancy nights
findings.finding_text: The sentence denies block credit on sell-out nights and the sentence is self-contradictory; there is no 95% occupancy credit.
findings.cd_standard: Full credit toward the block for any night the Hotel reaches 95% occupancy or higher.
findings.proposed_language: For any night the Hotel achieves 95% occupancy or higher, Group will receive full credit toward its block commitment for that night.
findings.redline_note: Gives the group full block credit for nights when the Hotel is nearly full.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Complimentary internet access and any discounted or complimentary services relating to audio-visual provision, including concessions, upgrades, or technical support at no charge, shall be conditioned upon the Group's exclusive use of the Hotel's in-house audio-visual provider for all function space during the Event. Should the Group elect to contract with an outside audio-visual vendor or bring its own equipment into any function room, the Group shall forfeit all complimentary internet services, discounted rates, and any other concessions the Hotel has offered in connection with in-house provision, and the Group shall pay the Hotel's then-current rate for internet access and technical support.
findings.headline: Free internet conditioned on using in-house AV
findings.finding_text: Using an outside AV vendor forfeits complimentary internet and discounts, penalizing the group's vendor choice.
findings.cd_standard: Use of in-house AV never a condition of discounted or complimentary services such as internet.
findings.proposed_language: Use of Hotel's in-house audio-visual provider, exclusively or otherwise, will not be a condition of any discounted or complimentary service, such as internet.
findings.redline_note: Removes the in-house audio-visual condition from complimentary services.

findings.quoted_text: A resort fee of $35.00 per occupied room per night shall be charged to all rooms in the block. This resort fee is in addition to all room rates and shall be applied to every room night, including complimentary room nights that Group may receive. The resort fee shall be invoiced monthly and shall be due within thirty (30) days of invoice date.
findings.headline: Resort fee charged on every room including complimentary
findings.finding_text: The fee adds $35 per occupied night to the $289 rate, including on complimentary rooms.
findings.cd_standard: Resort fee waived for attendees with resort-fee services still honored; no early check-in or checked-bag fees.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will waive the resort fee for all attendees while continuing to honor the resort fee services. Hotel will not charge attendees an early check-in fee when their room type is available, and will waive checked-bag fees for attendees arriving before check-in time or departing after check-out time.
findings.redline_note: Waives the resort fee while keeping its services available to attendees.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this agreement, the following shall not constitute force majeure: government-issued travel restrictions, travel advisories, or governmental directives limiting group gatherings or travel, regardless of the reason such restrictions or advisories are issued; epidemics, pandemics, or declarations of public health emergency, including any government responses thereto; or concerns among Group members regarding attendee safety, willingness to travel, or health considerations.
findings.headline: Epidemics, advisories and travel restrictions excluded from force majeure
findings.finding_text: The contract narrows force majeure to physical impossibility and expressly excludes epidemics, government restrictions and safety concerns. A group facing a health emergency or attendee cancellations would have no excuse and could face cancellation damages.
findings.cd_standard: Either party should be able to cancel without liability when a cause beyond its control would, in its reasonable judgment, make performance illegal, impossible, commercially impracticable, or inadvisable (including for health or safety reasons), or would cause or lead Group to reasonably anticipate cancellations by 20% or more of attendees. Qualifying causes should explicitly include terrorism, disease and epidemics, CDC and government travel advisories, government closures and emergency declarations, and government, corporate, and educational travel restrictions, alongside the traditional list. Group should keep this right even for conditions known at signing; if Group holds a smaller meeting instead, the hotel should waive attrition, F&B, and rental fees and offer the lowest rate it offers anyone. Deposits should be refunded promptly.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel makes no representation, warranty, or covenant regarding the accessibility of its facilities under the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended, or any state or local accessibility law, and Group assumes sole responsibility for assessing the suitability of the Hotel's premises for Group's attendees and event purposes.
findings.headline: Hotel disclaims accessibility compliance; Group funds all aids
findings.finding_text: The Hotel gives no accessibility warranty, and the group must fund auxiliary aids everywhere in the building, including guest rooms and common areas. The group could be exposed to costs and claims tied to the Hotel's own facilities.
findings.cd_standard: The hotel should warrant that its guest rooms, common areas, function space, and transportation services comply with the ADA's public accommodation requirements, with each party indemnifying the other only for its own ADA obligations and a clear division of who funds auxiliary aids in event space (group) versus guest rooms and common areas (hotel).

document_notes.detail: Section 1 says "Hotel will hold a block of 340 guest rooms on the peak night at a group rate of $289.00 per room, per night, single or double occupancy, exclusive of applicable state and local occupancy taxes." while the table lists "170" rooms on every night.
document_notes.headline: Room block size in the text differs from the rate table.

document_notes.detail: Section 14 says "no function room is named or reserved in this Agreement" while Exhibit A says "The function space set out below is held on a tentative basis and will be confirmed upon Hotel's receipt of Group's signed agreement." Exhibit A lists no square footage or ceiling heights.
document_notes.headline: Function space is unnamed in Section 14 but named in Exhibit A.

document_notes.detail: Section 2 charges "for each unoccupied room within the block" but then calculates "multiplying the nightly room rate by the number of occupied rooms multiplied by the applicable damage rate".
document_notes.headline: Attrition damage formula contradicts itself on which rooms are charged.

document_notes.detail: Section 2 states "Group shall receive no credit toward its block commitment for nights on which the Hotel sells out all available rooms in the Hotel, and occupancy on such nights shall be deemed to have satisfied the threshold regardless of the actual number of rooms occupied from the block."
document_notes.headline: Sell-out night sentence both denies credit and deems the threshold satisfied.

document_notes.detail: Section 19 says "the Group waives any right to dispute or withhold payment of billed amounts after receipt of an invoice from the Hotel" but later allows objection "unless the Group provides written notice of a discrepancy within the timeframe specified in the master account documentation", which is not attached.
document_notes.headline: Invoice dispute rights are withheld and granted in the same paragraph.

document_notes.detail: Section 17 says "The Hotel shall provide complimentary room nights to Group based on a ratio of one (1) complimentary room per seventy-five (75) paid room nights occupied during the Event Period." but later says the ratio "is a guideline only and does not create an entitlement in Group."
document_notes.headline: Complimentary rooms are promised in one sentence and denied as an entitlement in another.

document_notes.detail: Section 7 says the Hotel may cancel "in its sole discretion" but "only in the event of an unforeseen circumstance that materially impairs the Hotel's ability to perform its obligations hereunder".
document_notes.headline: Hotel's cancellation right is described as both sole discretion and limited.
